With nothing to underwrite, there is no trade to make.

Selling anything into a frozen-talks, oil-shock, FOMC-minutes tape with no confirmed name is not a Sniper. Sell nothing new today.
focus.why: Why YELLOW, not GREEN? The gap-risk numbers are borderline — composite 54 (WARM) and P(≥1% gap) ~35%, right on the trigger — and a GREEN light means deploy normal size, but there is nothing to deploy into: the scanner boarded zero qualifying setups. On top of that, FOMC minutes at 2pm, a frozen U.S.–Iran negotiation with the blockade still on, Brent near $92, and the 30-year yield at a near-two-decade high keep an open-ended tail alive. Not RED, because the tape is orderly rather than panicked and the numbers are still short of the HOT lock — but the honest stance is YELLOW: no new credit spreads today, keep cash, and re-run the scan tomorrow pre-open.
